subject: VerdantLoop — private deployment onboarding and network preflight
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@verdantloop.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Jul 2028 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: VerdantLoop — private deployment onboarding and network preflight

Hi Samira,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for VerdantLoop's private deployment. To make the first week of onboarding productive we'd like to align on a short preflight and mutual action plan focused on networking and the on-prem package handoff.

Top items we want to confirm before the kickoff call:
- VPC peering model (managed peering vs. customer-managed) and expected CIDR ranges
- Private endpoints (which services will require private DNS names + TLS cert responsibilities)
- On-prem package scope (agent vs. full appliance, storage requirements, HSM/KMS integration)
- Audit/logging access: S3/Cloud Storage or collector endpoints and retention windows

I've attached a lightweight checklist to drive the call and a draft mutual action plan where we can assign owners. Proposed times for a 60-minute kickoff next week:
- Tue 10–11am PT
- Wed 1–2pm PT
- Thu 8–9am PT

Please let me know which slot works and whether Lars (your infra lead) should join — if you prefer, we can run an initial tech-only sync first and then loop in procurement/security.

Attachments: vpc-peering-checklist.xlsx (stub), VerdantLoop_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.docx (stub)

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@verdantloop.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lars Meinhardt <lars@verdantloop.com>, VerdantLoop-Infra <infra@verdantloop.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Jul 2028 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: VerdantLoop — private deployment onboarding and network preflight

Hi Karthik — thanks for the note and the checklist.

We can take Tue 10–11am PT for the kickoff. Lars will join and I added our security SME (infra@verdantloop.com) to the thread. A couple of clarifications up front so the call can be actionable:
- We plan to use customer-managed peering (AWS Transit Gateway) but want Redwood to validate the proposed routing and NAT/bastion patterns.
- Private endpoints: we need private DNS for model-query, embeddings, and metrics ingestion. We'll be responsible for cert issuance via our internal CA; please confirm Redwood's requirements for cert SANs and auto-renewal compatibility.
- On-prem: initial install will be the agent bundle (not full appliance). Disk and NFS mount recommendations would be helpful — we'll share current capacity.

I've attached our internal network diagram (sent separately to infra) and a short list of compliance controls the security team will review.

Thanks — see you Tue.
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Engineering, VerdantLoop
samira.khan@verdantloop.com | +1 (650) 777-4444

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@verdantloop.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Jul 2028 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: VerdantLoop — private deployment onboarding and network preflight

Samira, Lars — great, Tue 10am PT is on our calendar (invite sent). Action items before the call:
- VerdantLoop: share CIDR ranges, proposed TGW attachments, and your internal CA cert profile (Lars/infra) — add those to the Drive folder linked below.
- Redwood: we will prepare a short runbook covering peering validation, required security group rules, and the agent install checklist (Monica owning agent docs).

Quick notes on the certs: Redwood supports standard SAN entries and ACME-style renewals for customer-issued certs. For private DNS we will use split-horizon records and provide an FQDN template (e.g., models.verdantloop.private.redwood). We'll validate TLS handshake behavior during staging.

I've uploaded an initial version of the on-prem manifest that lists disk, memory, and network ports we observe in comparable installs — see onprem-install-manifest.pdf in the Drive link. Grace will run a short internal preflight to map any network rules that might block KV cache or streaming token channels.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleLinkPLA
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/348921/VID-0091
Jira: RDW-1427 (deployment/peering validation)

See you Tue.
Karthik

Attachment: onprem-install-manifest.pdf (stub)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@verdantloop.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lars Meinhardt <lars@verdantloop.com>, VerdantLoop-Infra <infra@verdantloop.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Jul 2028 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: VerdantLoop — private deployment onboarding and network preflight

Perfect — we've dropped the CIDRs and our TGW diagram into the Drive folder and added a short notes doc for the security controls review. Lars will be on the call and will bring specific routing questions; our infra team will also open a read-only access for Redwood to view the staging VPC config if that helps.

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough.
Samira
